literal_meaning: না ইব চ না ইব চ (শব্দশঃ অর্থে অসম্ভবতার পুনরাবৃত্তি)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কখনো বিশ্বাস করবে না, নৈবচ নৈবচ।
example_sentences_in_english: He will never believe it, never ever.
This will never happen, absolutely not.
note: This appears to be a colloquial or dialectal expression emphasizing impossibility, possibly rhyming for effect in spoken Bengali.
